text:
jordan: Heads up — Oliver's birthday is next Tuesday (May 5). Planning a hybrid surprise. In-office: bagel bar at 10:30 + cake at 12:15. Remote: we'll send snack boxes. Who's in? :tada:
amelia: omg yay! count me in. can volunteer to pick up bagels 🥯
sanjay: i'll bring a card for the office, can someone DM me the spelling?
maya: i'd like to send a snack box — can we do a GF option for one of them?
jordan: yes, we'll have GF + vegan options. Quick poll: chocolate cake (:chocolate_bar:), lemon drizzle (:lemon:), or bagels only (:no_entry_sign:) — react to vote.
rita: :chocolate_bar:
tom: :lemon:
people-ops-bot: Reminder set — cake order due in 48 hours. Order link: https://orders.example.com/oliver-bday (placeholder)
amelia: also thinking a small group video card? i'll collect short clips and stitch. who's up to record 10s?
sanjay: happy to record — 10s is doable
oliver: wow, i'm touched. i'll be out of office that day but this is so sweet, no need to go overboard 😅
jordan: noted — we'll keep it low-key. last call for volunteers to pick up: @rita, @amelia
rita: happy to pick up cake if chocolate wins
maya: i'll coordinate snack-box addresses with people-ops and set a deadline for addresses (Fri noon)
amelia: i'll set up a google form for addresses + dietary prefs
jordan: thanks all — i'll post final RSVP & order confirmation tomorrow. :confetti_ball:
